About

I build high-end real-time experiences and AI-driven tools for architecture, virtual production and interactive media — from LED wall pipelines to browser-based 3D applications and generative AI pipelines.

Over the past 10+ years I've delivered projects for studios and brands across Brazil, Germany, the UK, the US and Canada, including time based in Berlin working across automotive visualisation for Hyundai and Genesis, Web3 experiences and large-scale worldbuilding. My work sits at the intersection of art and technology: environment art, lighting, look development, UI/UX for interactive apps, and deep performance profiling to hit frame-rate targets on any platform.

Today my pipelines are hybrid: 3ds Max and Corona Render, Unreal Engine, ComfyUI and AI video models such as Kling — from the first still to the moving image.

What I bring

  • Real-time architectural visualisation — interactive apps, configurators, Pixel Streaming
  • Hybrid pipelines — 3ds Max + Corona Render, Unreal Engine, ComfyUI and AI video (Kling and other models)
  • Web experiences for archviz — material configurators, 3D e-shops and first-person showrooms
  • Pipeline tools in Python — like the Scene Validator for Archviz for Unreal Engine
  • Virtual production pipelines optimised for LED wall environments
  • Performance profiling & optimisation — GPU/CPU, draw calls, shader complexity
  • Environment creation with Unreal Engine procedural workflows
  • Generative AI pipelines and AI agents — PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, ComfyUI, LangChain
  • Mentoring and knowledge-sharing — 4.5+ years teaching Unreal Engine

Precisely planned, cleanly executed, measurably fast.
